actions.description: Add Fireflies bot to a live meeting by URL.
actions.name: add-to-live

url.description: A valid HTTP URL for the meeting link, e.g. Google Meet, Zoom, etc.

title.description: Title or name of the meeting. Maximum length is 256 characters.

displayName.description: Display name of the attendee as it appears in meeting platforms.

actions.description: Continue an existing AskFred conversation thread.
actions.name: continue-askfred-thread

thread_id.description: The ID of the existing AskFred thread to continue. Example: "thread_abc123"

query.description: Follow-up question or query. Maximum 2000 characters.

response_language.description: Language code for the response (e.g., "en" for English).

actions.description: Start a new AskFred AI conversation thread
actions.name: create-askfred-thread

query.description: Question or query about the meeting(s). Maximum 2000 characters. Example: "What were the main action items?"

transcript_id.description: Specific transcript ID to query. If provided, filters are ignored.

filters.description: Filters to search across multiple meetings. Only used when transcript_id is not provided.

organizers.description: Organizer email addresses to filter by

participants.description: Participant email addresses to filter by

transcript_ids.description: Specific transcript IDs to filter by

actions.description: Create a soundbite clip from a transcript segment
actions.name: create-bite

start_time.description: Start time of the bite in seconds. Example: 0

end_time.description: End time of the bite in seconds. Example: 5

name.description: Name of the bite. Maximum length is 256 characters.

media_type.description: Type of the bite, either "video" or "audio"

privacies.description: Array specifying the visibility of the Soundbite.

summary.description: Summary for the bite. Maximum length is 500 characters.

actions.description: Create a live action item during an active meeting.
actions.name: create-live-action-item

meeting_id.description: The ID of the live meeting to create the action item for. Example: "abc123"

prompt.description: Natural language description of the action item to create. Example: "Follow up with the client about the proposal"

actions.description: Create a soundbite/clip during an active live meeting
actions.name: create-live-soundbite

meeting_id.description: The ID of the live meeting to create the soundbite for. Example: "abc123"

prompt.description: Natural language description of the soundbite to create. Min 5, max 255 characters. Example: "Create a soundbite from the last 2 minutes"

actions.description: Delete an AskFred conversation thread and all its messages.
actions.name: delete-askfred-thread

id.description: The unique identifier of the AskFred thread to delete. Example: "thread_abc123"

actions.description: Permanently delete a transcript by ID.
actions.name: delete-transcript

actions.description: Get conversation analytics for a date range.
actions.name: get-analytics

start_time.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

end_time.description: End date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z"

actions.description: Retrieve an AskFred conversation thread with all messages.
actions.name: get-askfred-thread

id.description: The unique identifier of the AskFred thread to retrieve. Example: "thread_abc123"

actions.description: Retrieve a specific bite/soundbite by ID.
actions.name: get-bite

actions.description: Retrieve a specific channel by ID.
actions.name: get-channel

channel_id.description: The unique identifier of the channel to fetch. Example: "channel-id-1"

actions.description: Retrieve a single transcript by ID including sentences, summary, speakers, and metadata.
actions.name: get-transcript

actions.description: Retrieve a specific user by ID.
actions.name: get-user

id.description: User ID. Omit to return the authenticated user.

actions.description: List currently active/live meetings
actions.name: list-active-meetings

email.description: Filter active meetings by a specific user email address. Example: "user@example.com"

states.description: Filter active meetings by their state. Possible values: "active", "paused". If omitted, both states are returned.

id.description: Unique identifier for the active meeting. Example: "meeting-id-1"

title.description: Title of the active meeting. Example: "Team Standup"

organizer_email.description: Email address of the meeting organizer. Example: "user@example.com"

meeting_link.description: The URL link to join the meeting. Example: "https://zoom.us/j/123456789"

start_time.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the meeting started. Example: "2024-01-15T10:00:00.000Z"

end_time.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the meeting is scheduled to end. Example: "2024-01-15T11:00:00.000Z"

privacy.description: Privacy setting for the meeting. Possible values: "link", "owner", "participants", "teammates_and_participants", "participating_teammates", "teammates"

state.description: Current state of the meeting. Possible values: "active", "paused"

actions.description: List AskFred AI conversation threads, optionally filtered by transcript.
actions.name: list-askfred-threads

transcript_id.description: Filter threads to only those associated with a specific transcript ID. Example: "transcript_xyz789"

actions.description: List soundbite clips with optional filters.
actions.name: list-bites

mine.description: Fetch bites owned by the API key owner.

transcript_id.description: Filter bites by a specific transcript ID.

my_team.description: Fetch bites for the API key owner's team.

limit.description: Maximum number of bites to fetch. Max 50.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

actions.description: List all channels in the workspace.
actions.name: list-channels

created_by.description: User ID of the creator. Example: "user-id-1"

actions.description: List all contacts in the workspace.
actions.name: list-contacts

actions.description: List transcripts with optional filters.
actions.name: list-transcripts

fromDate.description: Return all transcripts created after this date. ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-07-08T22:13:46.660Z"

toDate.description: Return all transcripts created before this date. ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-07-08T22:13:46.660Z"

limit.description: Number of transcripts to return. Maximum 50 in one query.

title.description: Deprecated. Use keyword instead. Title of the transcript. Mutually exclusive with keyword.

keyword.description: Allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting. Mutually exclusive with title.

scope.description: Specify the scope for keyword search. If scope is provided, keyword becomes a required field. Defaults to TITLE if no value is provided.

user_id.description: User id. Filter all meetings that have this user ID as the organizer or participant.

mine.description: Filter all meetings that have the API key owner as the organizer.

organizers.description: Filter meetings that have any of these emails as organizers. Accepts an array of email addresses.

participants.description: Filter meetings that contain any of these emails as attendees. Accepts an array of email addresses.

channel_id.description: Filter meetings that belong to a specific channel. Accepts a single channel ID.

host_email.description: Filter all meetings accordingly to meetings that have this email as the host.

organizer_email.description: Deprecated. Use organizers instead. Filter meetings that have this email as the organizer.

participant_email.description: Deprecated. Use participants instead. Filter meetings that contain this email as an attendee.

actions.description: List user groups, optionally filtered to mine.
actions.name: list-user-groups

mine.description: If true, returns only user groups the current user belongs to.

actions.description: List all users in the workspace.
actions.name: list-users

actions.description: Revoke a previously shared meeting access.
actions.name: revoke-shared-meeting-access

meeting_id.description: The unique identifier of the meeting / transcript.

email.description: The email address of the user whose shared access should be revoked.

actions.description: Share a meeting transcript via email with optional expiry
actions.name: share-meeting

emails.description: Email addresses to share with. Up to 50 emails per request.

expiry_days.description: Optional expiry period in days. Allowed values: 7, 14, or 30.

actions.description: Assign transcripts to a channel
actions.name: update-meeting-channel

transcript_ids.description: Array of Transcript IDs to update. Must contain 1–5 items. Example: ["transcript_id_1"]

actions.description: Update the privacy setting of a meeting transcript.
actions.name: update-meeting-privacy

actions.description: Pause or resume a live meeting recording.
actions.name: update-meeting-state

actions.description: Update the title of a meeting transcript.
actions.name: update-meeting-title

actions.description: Submit an audio file URL for transcription.
actions.name: upload-audio

url.description: The URL of the media file to be transcribed. Example: "https://example.com/audio.mp3"

title.description: Title or name of the meeting. Example: "Weekly sync"

syncs.description: Sync conversation analytics for rolling date windows
syncs.name: analytics

syncs.description: Full-refresh sync of contacts derived from meeting participants.
syncs.name: contacts

syncs.description: Full-refresh sync of all transcript sentences, fetched per transcript.
syncs.name: transcript-sentences

syncs.description: Incrementally sync transcript metadata and structured notes using fromDate checkpoint
syncs.name: transcripts
